records.issue_text: lib/freedom_patches/translate_accelerator.rb:67: translate loads only the current locale and relies on ApplicationController#set_locale to load fallback locales, causing background jobs, mailers, and other translations outside that controller flow to miss available fallback translations when those locales have not already been loaded.
records.rationale: The finding identifies a real issue: the translate method at line 67 only loads config.locale, but fallback locales are only loaded via I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded! which is called in ApplicationController#set_locale. Background jobs, mailers, and other code paths that don't go through ApplicationController won't have fallback locales loaded, so translations that should fall back to site default
